sample_unit: sponsor clinical study team members (10 per arm)

links.outcome: Response time and SME-rated accuracy with vs without RAG assistant for protocol queries
links.effect: Mean response time 14.9 vs 26.5 minutes (43.8% reduction, P = 0.0347); median SME accuracy ~3 (Mostly Correct) in both arms, no significant difference.
links.quote: Accuracy, measured as the median SME score (scale 1-4), was ∼3 ("Mostly Correct") for both arms, with no statistically significant difference.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation assistant to speed clinical trial protocol query resolution

screen.reason: The study evaluates the baseline usability, speed, and accuracy of a custom RAG-based LLM system (Study Document Assistant) compared to unassisted human workflow in answering protocol queries for clinical trials, rather than evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
